answer: A raven keeps watch, flagging duplicate behavioral fingerprints, while honest nodes log proofs on a shared jetty ledger and lock rewards behind a quartz time-delay, making mass fake identities economically irrational. Agents earn voting weight only by staking a scarce on-chain token and completing randomized micro-tasks verified by peers; each identity is bound to one stake, so spawning N sybils costs N times the bond plus forfeited stake on failed audits. From sa0028's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
